findings.claim: The newly exported `Unwrap` type may not exist (or may not be exported) from `../../unstable-core-do-not-import`, which would break the package build.
findings.rationale: This re-export assumes `Unwrap` is a public export of the core barrel file. If the corresponding export was not added there, TypeScript will fail with TS2459/TS2305. Worth verifying the core barrel actually exports `Unwrap`. Medium confidence — I could not inspect the barrel from the hunk alone.

findings.claim: Exposing an internal utility type `Unwrap` as `TRPCUnwrap` on the public entrypoint widens the public API surface even though it is marked `@internal`.
findings.rationale: `@internal` only strips the symbol from docs/declarations when `stripInternal` is enabled; otherwise consumers can import and depend on `TRPCUnwrap`, making future changes to it breaking. Also, generic utility names like `Unwrap` can collide conceptually with other exported helpers. Low-to-medium confidence that this is intentional, but worth a second look.
